justification: Inspected `zxingorg/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/web/OutputUtils.java`, `zxingorg/src/test/java/com/google/zxing/web/OutputUtilsTestCase.java`, and `zxingorg/src/main/webapp/w/decoderesult.jspx`. The class is tiny (55 lines), has only 1 public method (`arrayToString(byte[])`) plus 1 private helper and 2 constants, and its documented purpose is a single narrow concern: formatting raw bytes for `decoderesult.jspx`. It is used in only one production call site and one test, with no evidence of multiple responsibilities, many public methods, or separable concern groups.
